source_caption_text:
That time DJ Khaled refused to let his Jordans touch the floor 😂😭

DJ Khaled took his love for sneakers to another level in November 2022 when he brought a custom silk pillow courtside at a Miami Heat game just to keep his shoes off the floor. The salmon-pink pillow featured his famous “WE THE BEST” slogan, making the entire setup impossible to miss.

Khaled was wearing his unreleased Air Jordan 5 “We The Best - Crimson Bliss” collaboration, explaining that the rare sneakers were too exclusive to touch the ground. The over-the-top setup quickly became one of the biggest talking points from the game, with fans and commentators amused by the dedication.

The moment soon went viral and became another classic example of Khaled’s larger-than-life personality. His commitment to protecting his rare sneakers was so serious that he later repeated the pillow stunt with another exclusive pair, proving he was fully committed to the lifestyle.
